chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Qasim al-Jarjani, the exegete, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated to us, saying: Abu Ya'qub Yusuf ibn Muhammad ibn Ziyad and Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Sayyar (who were from the Imami Shi'a) narrated to us from their fathers, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them,

regarding the saying of Allah, Glorious and Exalted is He: 'In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.' He said: Allah is He to whom all creatures seek divinity at times of needs and hardships, when hope is cut off from everyone besides Him, and means are disconnected from all others. You say: 'In the name of Allah,' meaning: I seek assistance in all my affairs from Allah, to whom servitude is due alone, the Succorer when succor is sought, and the Responder when called upon. This is what a man said to al-Sadiq (peace be upon him): 'O son of Allah's Messenger, guide me to Allah, what is He? For the polemicists have overwhelmed me and confused me.' He said to him: 'O servant of Allah, have you ever boarded a ship?' He said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Then, did it break with you to the extent that no ship could save you, nor swimming suffice for you?' He said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Then, did it connect to your heart that there is a thing among things that is able to save you from your hazard?' He said: 'Yes.' Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: 'Then, that Thing is Allah, the One Able to rescue when there is no rescuer, and to succor when there is no succorer.'

key_terms.يُتَأَلَّهُ: To be worshipped/sought as a deity

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Bismillah' according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, this narration elucidates the theological depth of the Basmala by defining Allah as the sole recipient of worship (*al-ilah*) when all created means (*asbab*) are exhausted. The Imam employs the vivid analogy of a shipwreck to demonstrate that true reliance (*tawakkul*) is recognized precisely in moments of absolute helplessness, affirming Allah as the unique Rescuer (*al-Munji*) where no other savior exists.
